Phosphur is rebuilt from scratch as a tabbed browser that runs inside your browser.

> [!WARNING]
> **Breaking changes.** Do these before you upgrade.
>
> - **Proxy engine:** Pages now load through Scramjet and Wisp instead of Ultraviolet, so self-hosters need to redeploy from this release.
> - **Running it:** Phosphur now runs on Bun 1.2 or newer, so install Bun before upgrading a self-hosted copy.

## New

- **Tabs:** Open, close, reorder and switch tabs, each with its own page and back/forward history.
- **Omnibox:** Type a URL, a domain or a search, with a choice of search engines or your own template.
- **Wisp server:** Use the built-in Wisp endpoint or any other Wisp server, with a status dot showing its latency.
- **History and bookmarks:** Your history and bookmarks stay in your browser and show up on the New Tab page.
- **Session restore:** The tabs you had open last time come back when you return.
- **Cloaking:** Open Phosphur in an about:blank tab, disguise the tab, and set a panic key that leaves for a safe page.
- **Keyboard shortcuts:** Alt-key shortcuts open, close and switch tabs, even inside open pages.
- **Install as an app:** Phosphur can be installed as a PWA.
- **Docker:** A Dockerfile builds and runs the whole site in one container, with a health check that Docker and hosts like Coolify can read.
- **Cloudflare WARP:** An optional Compose file routes the server's traffic through Cloudflare WARP, so sites see a Cloudflare IP instead of yours; see the README.

## Improved

- **Design:** The blue Mica look returns with translucent Windows 11-style surfaces in dark and light themes.
